71155-facing-the-chair.title: Facing The Chair
71155-facing-the-chair.creator: Unknown
71155-facing-the-chair.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Save them for your honor, for the honor of your children, and for the generations yet unborn. DEBS TO THE WORKERS OF AMERICA_ _Gene Debs is dead. Gene Debs lives in the hearts and minds of millions of Americans. This is his last appeal for justice._ The supreme court of Massachusetts has spoken at last and Bartolomeo Vanzetti and Nicola Sacco, two of the bravest and best scouts that ever served the labor movement, must go to the electric chair.

arxiv-2004-02574.title: Real-Time Segmentation Networks should be Latency Aware
arxiv-2004-02574.creator: Evann Courdier, François Fleuret
arxiv-2004-02574.description: Abstract As scene segmentation systems reach visually accurate results, many recent papers focus on making these network architectures faster, smaller and more efficient. In particular, studies often aim at designing ‘real-time’ systems. Achieving this goal is particularly relevant in the context of real-time video understanding for autonomous vehicles, and robots.

arxiv-2101-03645.title: Shear-thinning in Oligomer Melts - Molecular Origins and Hybrid Multiscale Simulations
arxiv-2101-03645.creator: Ranajay Datta, Leonid Yelash, Friederike Schmid, Florian Kummer, Martin Oberlack, Mária Lukáčová-Medvi d’ ová, Peter Virnau
arxiv-2101-03645.description: Abstract We investigate the molecular origin of shear-thinning in melts of flexible, semiflexible and rigid oligomers with coarse-grained simulations of a sheared melt. Alignment, stretching and tumbling modes or suppression of the latter all contribute to understanding how macroscopic flow properties emerge from the molecular level.

arxiv-2103-06886.title: A Delphes card for the EIC yellow-report detector
arxiv-2103-06886.creator: Miguel Arratia, Stephen Sekula
arxiv-2103-06886.description: Abstract The Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) Yellow Report specified parameters for the general-purpose detector that can deliver the scientific goals delineated by the EIC White Paper and NAS report. These parameters dictate the tracking momentum resolution, secondary-vertex resolutions, calorimeter energy resolutions, as well as π / K / p \pi/K/p ID.

arxiv-2407-08997.title: Asymptotic Expansions for Semilinear Waves on Asymptotically Flat Spacetimes
arxiv-2407-08997.creator: Sam Looi, Haoren Xiong
arxiv-2407-08997.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sam Looi, Haoren Xiong. We establish precise asymptotic expansions for solutions to semilinear wave equations with power-type nonlinearities on asymptotically flat spacetimes. Our analysis focuses on two key cases: cubic nonlinearities and higher-order power nonlinearities. For cubic nonlinearities of the form a ⁡ ( t , x ) ​ ϕ 3 a(t,x)\,\phi^{3} , we prove asymptotic expansions for the solution globally in the spacetime.

arxiv-2408-05405.title: Locally noetherian quiver representations
arxiv-2408-05405.creator: Henning Krause
arxiv-2408-05405.description: Abstract . It is shown that a quiver is left noetherian if and only if the category of quiver representations in any locally noetherian abelian category is again locally noetherian. Here, locally noetherian means that any object is the directed union of its noetherian subobjects.

arxiv-2412-21068.title: Finite Horizon Optimization: Framework and Applications ∗
arxiv-2412-21068.creator: Yushun Zhang, Dmitry Rybin, Zhi-Quan Luo
arxiv-2412-21068.description: Abstract In modern engineering scenarios, there is often a strict upper bound on the number of algorithm iterations that can be performed within a given time limit. This raises the question of optimal algorithmic configuration for a fixed and finite iteration budget.

arxiv-2508-15445.title: Higher-order network adaptivity: co-evolution of higher-order structure and spreading dynamics
arxiv-2508-15445.creator: Longzhao Liu 1,3,5,6,7, Hongwei Zheng 8, Zhihao Han 1,3, Xin Wang 1,3,5,6,7, Shaoting Tang 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
arxiv-2508-15445.description: Abstract The co-evolution of structure and dynamics, known as adaptivity, is a fundamental property in various systems and drives diverse emergent behaviors. However, the adaptivity in previous works is primarily stemmed from pairwise situations, while is insufficient to capture ubiquitous higher-order characteristics of real systems.

britannica-1911-nisbett-louisa-cranstoun.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-nisbett-louisa-cranstoun.description: Article 'Nisbett, Louisa Cranstoun' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 19), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was the daughter of Frederick Hayes Macnamara, an actor, whose stage name was Mordaunt. As Miss Mordaunt she had considerable experience, especially in Shakespearean leading parts, before her first London appearance in 1829 at Drury Lane as Widow Cheerly in Andrew Cherry's (1762–1812) Soldier's Daughter.

pmc-10644026.title: Is corticophobia spreading among pediatricians?—Insights from a self-efficacy survey on the management of pediatric atopic dermatitis
pmc-10644026.creator: Nicolas Andre, Atar Ben Shmuel, Lior Yahav, Liezl Muallem, Inbal Golan Tripto, Amir Horev
pmc-10644026.description: BackgroundAtopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic dermatological condition, often diagnosed and managed by pediatricians. However, pediatricians have difficulties with adhering to guidelines, which recommend the use of topical corticosteroids (TCS) as a first-line treatment and oral corticosteroids (OCS) for resistant cases.

pmc-11455328.title: 12324 Clinical Features And PHEX Variants Of Adults With X-Linked Hypophosphatemia
pmc-11455328.creator: L P Valadares, D R Carvalho, F S Lopes, R S Oliveira, L G Castro
pmc-11455328.description: Disclosure: L.P. Valadares: None. D.R. Carvalho: None. F.S. Lopes: None. R.S. Oliveira: None. L.G. Castro: None.X-linked hypophosphatemia (XLH), caused by loss-of-function PHEX mutations, is a lifelong renal phosphate-wasting disorder and the main cause of inherited hypophosphatemia. In adults, chronic hypophosphatemia leads to impaired bone mineralization and persistent osteomalacia.

pmc-11868867.creator: Huan-Jui Yeh, Ruo-Yan Wu
pmc-11868867.description: Objectives This study aims to investigate the effects of different kinesiotaping methods on muscle contraction of fatigued biceps. Patients and methods Between April 01, 2019 to September 30, 2019, a total of 24 adults (11 males, 13 females; mean age: 31.8±6.1 years; range, 24 to 47 years) were recruited in the study.

pmc-13074213.title: Structure–Activity Relationships of Hemocompatible Cationic 6-Azaindole Pyridinium Salts: Antimicrobial and Anticancer Activity
pmc-13074213.creator: Roxana Ciorteanu, Ioana C. Marinas, Catalina Ionica Ciobanu, Ionel I. Mangalagiu, Ramona Danac
pmc-13074213.description: A series of 6-azaindole pyridinium derivatives were synthesized, structurally characterized, and evaluated for their antimicrobial (against Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, and Candida albicans) and anticancer properties (against NCI 60 panel). Hemocompatibility was evaluated using the hemolytic index, while ADME properties were estimated using in silico methods.

pmc-13139309.title: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in Cleft Care: A Scoping Review
pmc-13139309.creator: Brooke Streeter, Michael Bezuhly
pmc-13139309.description: Introduction: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used to support the diagnosis and treatment of medical and surgical conditions. This scoping review examined AI applications in cleft lip and palate care, focusing on diagnosis/detection, surgical planning, and patient education. Methods: PubMed, Embase, and Scopus databases were searched. Results were uploaded to the Covidence systematic review software.

pmc-13557288.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe growing influence of social media in healthcare raises ethical, regulatory, and professional concerns. Dermatology, positioned at the intersection of clinical, surgical, and aesthetic medicine, faces unique challenges in navigating this digital landscape.ObjectivesTo assess how dermatology professionals in Italy use social media; identify behavioural patterns and sociodemographic correlates; and explore perceived challenges, educational needs, and the potential role of institutional guidance.MethodsA cross-sectional online survey was conducted among Italian dermatologists, residents, students, and nurses (n = 201).

pmc-13599660.creator: Michael Grimm, Ruben Lau, Fiona Mankertz, Robin Bülow, Felix Morof, Delphine Nombret, Camille Dumont, Vincent Jannin, Mladen Vassilev Tzvetkov, Werner Weitschies
pmc-13599660.description: Different grades of hypromellose acetate succinate (HPMCAS) differ in their pH dependent dissolution behavior, which is of key relevance when used for enteric coating or gastroresistant capsule shells. By use of specific grades it could be possible to tailor intestinal release in terms of timing and localization.

pmc-13679186.title: Metagenomics identifies distinct functional and taxonomic profiles between freshwaters and associated sediments in alpine habitats
pmc-13679186.creator: Anita Gattei, Sara Vettorazzo, Massimo Pindo, Nico Salmaso, Paolo Manghi, Stefano Larsen, Claudio Donati
pmc-13679186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAlpine freshwater habitats are biodiversity hotspots, home to uniquely adapted microbial communities. However, our understanding of how taxonomic composition and metabolic potential of microbial communities varies across habitat type and physiography remains limited.ResultsUsing metagenomic sequencing, we examined microbial diversity and functions in sediment and water habitats across a physiographic gradient, including deep and shallow lakes, pasture ponds, ponds and peat bogs. Overall, sediments supported more diverse and even microbial communities.
